question: Can I activate ninjutsu before blockers are declared, since my attacking creature has not been blocked yet?

expected.shortAnswer: No: ninjutsu can be activated only after blockers have been declared.
expected.answer: The ninjutsu ability can be activated only after blockers have been declared. Before then, attacking creatures are neither blocked nor unblocked.

whyHard: An attacker that has not been blocked yet looks unblocked, but before blockers it is neither blocked nor unblocked.
